claim: For the two-layer generalized Mycielski graph \(M_2(C_5)\), the game chromatic number is exactly \(\chi_g(M_2(C_5))=4\). Equivalently, Bob can prevent completion with three colors, while Alice has a winning strategy with four colors in the standard vertex-coloring game. The four-color upper bound is certified by an exhaustive minimax search over the complete finite game tree, quotiented only by the ten dihedral automorphisms of the base \(C_5\) and by global color relabeling; the same checker independently confirms the three-color lower bound.
integrity: The checker uses the exact published graph definition and exact game quantifiers. It performs no randomized search, numerical approximation, depth cutoff, or unproved pruning; the only quotient operations are verified graph automorphisms and global color relabeling.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only \(M_2(C_5)\); no extension to larger cycles or higher generalized-Mycielski depth is claimed.
The upper bound is computer-assisted and represented by an exhaustive minimax computation rather than a compact explicit strategy table.
title: Exact game chromatic number of \(M_2(C_5)\)
